meta.name: chrome-automation
meta.description: Connect to and control Google Chrome browser using agent-browser with CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol). Use when the user wants to automate their existing Chrome browser, see browser actions in real-time, or needs to control the Chrome instance they're already using. Handles installation, setup, connecting via remote debugging, and all browser automation tasks with live visual feedback.

copy.tagline_en: Automate web tasks in your real Chrome browser with live visual feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control Chrome programmatically for repetitive web tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 CDP 协议连接并控制你电脑上正在运行的 Chrome 浏览器，自动执行打开网页、填写表单、点击按钮等操作，并实时截图展示浏览器状态。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 自动化操作你现有的 Chrome 浏览器，或需要实时看到浏览器中的操作过程时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开小红书，搜索 labubu。
自动填写这个登录表单并提交。
say.note: Claude 会获取页面元素、填入信息并提交。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can connect to and control your running Chrome browser via CDP, automating tasks like opening pages, filling forms, clicking buttons, and taking real-time screenshots of the browser state.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to automate your existing Chrome browser or need to see browser actions in real-time.

say_en.text: Open Xiaohongshu and search for labubu.
Fill in this login form and submit it automatically.
say_en.note: Claude will get page elements, fill in the fields, and submit.
